required_risk.note: A perfect day means every open position hits its target on the same day and nothing else loses. This variant pays 1.75R at the target (3.5 ATR / 2 ATR, the system's momentum distances). Under the 3% open-risk cap that day pays at most 5.25%. Reaching 10% needs 5.714...% of equity at risk: 1.904...% on each of three positions, or 2.857...% on each of two. The 1.5x gap rule pins size at 1% unless max_gap_risk_pct is lifted with it. config.yaml is not modified.
